headline: Two Tankers Damaged by Projectiles in Strait of Hormuz Near Oman
summary: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported two commercial oil tankers suffered damage from unidentified projectiles near Khasab, Oman, including one hit directly in the engine room.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint, handling roughly a fifth of global petroleum supply. Attacks on maritime vessels in the passage heighten supply disruption risks and maritime insurance costs.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Security threats in the Strait of Hormuz immediately elevate geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of projectile attacks against commercial tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raised fears of potential oil transport bottlenecks.
